import sys

name = "文字文稿1"  # 文字文稿1
gbk = name.encode("gbk")
# The MCP server appears to encode argv as UTF-8, which the CLI then decodes as a
# DBCS codepage. Build the string that survives that round trip.
s = gbk.decode("utf-8", "surrogateescape")
out = s.encode("utf-8", "surrogateescape")
print("name      :", name)
print("gbk_bytes :", gbk.hex())
print("roundtrip :", out == gbk)
print("candidate_hex:", s.encode("utf-8", "surrogateescape").hex())
print("codepoints:", " ".join("U+%04X" % ord(c) for c in s))
sys.stdout.buffer.write(b"candidate_utf8: " + s.encode("utf-8", "surrogateescape") + b"\n")
